verdict.rationale: Supabase documents first-party self-hosting with Docker Compose in your own infrastructure, aimed at full data control, compliance, or isolated environments (supabase-docs-32, supabase-docs-3). The stack is open source (supabase-gh-1). The CLI runs the entire stack locally or in CI (supabase-docs-21), and that local stack also serves the MCP server at localhost:54321/mcp, which covers the AI-native angle (supabase-supp-mcp-config-params). One user reports easy local setup (supabase-comm-7), while another says Val Town's team couldn't get local development working (supabase-comm-14); that single local-dev anecdote doesn't contradict self-hosting. Missing for 10: documentation of feature parity between self-hosted and the managed platform (e.g., branching, backups, image transformations), and independent hands-on corroboration of production self-hosting and upgrades.
